mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_export_history (exported_at, tab_name, file_name, from_date, to_date, exported_by, row_count) VALUES (#{exportedAt}, #{tabName}, #{fileName}, #{fromDate}, #{toDate}, #{exportedBy}, #{rowCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, exported_at AS exportedAt, tab_name AS tabName, file_name AS fileName, from_date AS fromDate, to_date AS toDate, exported_by AS exportedBy, row_count AS rowCount FROM order_export_history ORDER BY exported_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
